answer: Identities are then ranked by a slowly decaying trust score, giving established agents a marble-hard reputation that newcomers cannot cheaply clone, while a small haven of vetted peers audits new entrants before they earn voting weight. Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher puzzle whose difficulty scales with its staked balance; a would-be sybil needs one distinct solution per puppet identity, so forging a thousand accounts costs a thousand times the compute and stake. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
